items.title: Paste a script, pick a voice
items.body: Paste or upload a script and read it from a teleprompter that cuts each shot for you, or pick one of five voices in six languages and let it read the story aloud while the panels draw.

items.title: An agent that checks every frame
items.body: A continuity supervisor now checks every character sheet and panel against written rubrics, fixes small slips like a stray vest on its own, and asks you about the rest.

items.title: Ready for the world
items.body: Frameteller now runs on its own production servers at app.frameteller.com, with fair limits for a busy public demo and a privacy page that says exactly what we keep.

items.title: A home at frameteller.com
items.body: Frameteller now lives at frameteller.com, and the old address and www both lead there.

items.title: Talk for a minute, get an animatic
items.body: You can now talk through a scene for a minute and download an animatic of the storyboard, timed to your words and voiced by your own narration.

items.title: The studio is open
items.body: You can now open the studio in your browser, tell a story out loud, tap Next shot at each new moment, approve the cast and watch the storyboard draw itself.

items.title: It's on the internet
items.body: The backend now runs on Azure, so anyone can narrate a scene to it over the internet and get shots, a cast and first panels back.

items.title: Talk to it, get shots back
items.body: You can now narrate a scene to the backend and watch shots, character sheets and first panels come back while you are still talking.

items.title: Connected to Meta's models
items.body: The backend now talks to all four Meta models it needs, listening, directing, drawing and selecting, and each one passed a live test against the real service.

items.title: Building the engine
items.body: Started the backend: story rules, cast approval and budget guards, all tested before any UI.

items.title: Proved the hard parts
items.body: Our test scenes kept the same girl and cat on model across every panel, one click selected her cleanly, and voice-style edits changed her coat without disturbing the rest of the picture.

items.title: Mapped the Meta APIs
items.body: Read the docs for live speech, image editing and segmentation, and confirmed the pipeline works end to end on paper.

items.title: Marketing page is live
items.body: This page is now deployed on Azure Static Web Apps from our public repo. Every push to main updates this build log within a minute.

items.title: Project kicked off
items.body: Picked the idea, wrote the build plan and put this page up. The public live demo goes up on Nov 2.

items.title: Proving the hard parts first
items.body: Testing speech-to-shot-list, and whether one character stays recognisable across six panels.
